name: listQualify
description: Inserts a string at the beginning and end of list elements.
syntax: listQualify( string list, string qualifier, [string delimiters], [string elements], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: qualifier
params.description: string to insert before and after the list elements specified in the elements parameter.

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: elements
params.description:
which type of element are qualified

- all (default): all elements
- char: elements that are composed of alphabetic characters

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well
